visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a sharp black tuxedo and black bowtie sits on a brown wooden chair on a raised stage. He carefully places a grey, patterned blindfold over his eyes, adjusting it for a snug fit. Behind him is a wide white projection screen with a subtle grey castle silhouette. The indoor lighting is bright and even. (2) The camera pans to show the banquet hall filled with guests seated at round tables. A female host wearing a flowing blue cape-style garment over a dress gestures enthusiastically towards the audience, calling people forward. Several guests, including men and women in formal attire, stand up and begin walking through the tables towards the stage. (3) A man in a light pink suit jacket and an older woman in a pink sleeveless dress approach the stage together, smiling and holding hands. They appear to be relatives participating in the surprise game. The background remains the elegant wedding hall with warm ambient light from ceiling chandeliers. (4) On the stage, the blindfolded groom sits waiting as the first contestant, a young man in a white tunic and purple vest, is guided towards him. The host stands nearby with a microphone. The groom reaches out and takes the contestant's hand, feeling it curiously while the audience watches with amusement. (5) The second contestant, the bride herself, steps up. She wears a magnificent light blue layered ballgown and a sparkling tiara on her head. She smiles widely as the groom takes her hand. The camera captures her joyful expression and the detailed textures of her elegant dress and shimmering tiara. (6) An older woman in a pink dress takes her turn. The groom grasps her hand and makes a funny face, prompting a wave of laughter from the audience. He seems to be commenting on the texture or size of the hand. The lighting remains bright, highlighting the participants' playful interactions. (7) A man in a pink suit steps up next. The groom touches his hand, and the host leans in with her microphone to catch his reaction. The scene is full of energy, with the background guests clearly enjoying the humor of a man touching another man's hand in a 'princess' game. (8) The fifth contestant is a man wearing a black t-shirt, glasses, and a black baseball cap. He holds out his hand in a limp, exaggerated manner. The groom touches it and laughs, seemingly recognizing that this is not his bride. The host continues her animated narration into the microphone. (9) A young woman in a white dress is the final contestant. The groom touches her hand briefly before the game concludes. He is then asked to make his final choice. The energy on stage is high, with everyone anticipating the reveal and the groom's likely incorrect or humorous guess. (10) The groom finally points to one of the earlier contestants. He pulls off his blindfold and bursts into laughter when he sees he has picked an older woman or a man instead of his bride. The real bride, standing nearby in her blue gown, laughs along with the entire room.

Frequent bursts of loud, high-arousal laughter and applause from the audience swell in the mix, occasionally competing with the host's speech. The playful BGM maintains its upbeat tempo throughout. (4) A distinctive cartoon-style 'ding' sound effect triggers as a contestant is assigned a number. The goal is for the blindfolded groom to identify his bride among several participants. It aims to entertain the wedding guests and capture a memorable, lighthearted moment for the couple.
